item.title: There is no "save as" dialogua when using Zoomit screen recording
item.author: Stimux

attachments_analyzed.public_summary: Downloaded for triage; ZoomIt log had initialization/settings reload events but no recording failure, save-dialog, or no-frame diagnostic line in inspected module log.

judgment.rationale: The report has concrete screen-recording steps and a public bug report, but logs do not show whether StopRecording reached save/trim, capture produced zero frames, or policy blocked the dialog.
evidence: Ctrl+5 starts recording and shows yellow frame; second Ctrl+5 removes it with no Save As and no MP4 found.
Reporter notes non-admin company PC and possible new policy.
ZoomIt code toggles StartRecordingAsync/StopRecording, has no-frame warning, and uses save/trim dialogs.
Diagnostic ZIP module log lacks decisive recording error lines.
judgment.recommended_action: Run maintainer reproduction on v0.101.2362+ and collect fresh trace if reproduced.

fix_assessment.rationale: A code fix is plausible, but current evidence does not distinguish capture failure, dialog suppression, path persistence, or endpoint policy.

issue_context.summary: ZoomIt screen recording starts visibly but stopping dismisses the border without showing Save As or leaving an MP4.
known_information: PowerToys v0.101.2362, Store install, ZoomIt, non-elevated.
Yellow recording frame appears on ultrawide display.
Issue started after ZoomIt temporarily stopped starting; updating restored other behavior.
A public diagnostic ZIP is attached.
inferences: The hotkey path partly works; failure is likely after recording start or during stop/save flow.
Company policy could affect capture/save UI but is unconfirmed.
issue_context.analysis: Treat as reproducible-first: multiple ZoomIt branches can stop with no saved file, and current logs do not identify the branch.
initial_investigation: Checked origin/main ZoomIt recording and save-dialog paths at 5abd20e355998a865075a06676bebfc1d9925be4.

information_gaps.information: Fresh recording-stop trace showing no-frame/capture failure, save dialog COM failure, or successful recording path.
information_gaps.why_needed: Identifies exact branch to fix and separates endpoint policy from PowerToys defect.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reproduce once, stop recording, then comment /bugreport immediately afterward.

steps: Install PowerToys 0.101.2362 or newer with ZoomIt enabled.
Set recording format to MP4 and leave PowerToys non-elevated.
Press Ctrl+5 and confirm the recording border appears.
Wait at least five seconds, press Ctrl+5 again, and observe save/trim UI.
Check Videos, Temp, and configured recording folder for an MP4.
reproduce.expected_result: Stopping recording should show save/trim flow or produce an MP4, not silently remove the border with no file.
setup_requirements: If possible, test first on an ultrawide display and then a standard monitor.

comment.body: Thanks for attaching the report. It confirms ZoomIt is enabled, but the ZoomIt log does not show the decisive recording-stop branch. Please reproduce once more and then comment `/bugreport` immediately afterward so we can see whether recording produced no frames, the save dialog failed, or company policy blocked capture/save UI.
